subject.title: fix(mattermost): proactive message tool sends ignore thread context

question: Which path should own the remaining Mattermost cron/heartbeat thread-context fix now that the message-tool half shipped?
rationale: The remaining bug is real, but linked candidate branches are stale, conflicting, abandoned, or broader than this issue, and choosing adoption, replacement, or closure requires maintainer ownership judgment.

options.title: Replace with focused fix
options.body: Sponsor a narrow current-main fix that writes or recovers routable non-direct Mattermost thread delivery context on the correct session entry and includes live cron/heartbeat proof.

options.title: Adopt existing candidate
options.body: Pick one linked PR, rebase it, address the known route/session risks, and make it the canonical fix path.

options.title: Close remaining scope
options.body: Close this issue and associated candidates only if maintainers decide Mattermost cron/heartbeat thread recovery is not planned.

recommendation.title: Replace with focused fix
recommendation.body: Sponsor a narrow current-main fix that writes or recovers routable non-direct Mattermost thread delivery context on the correct session entry and includes live cron/heartbeat proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They landed and verified the shipped message-tool fix while explicitly leaving this issue open for the remaining proactive-message behavior.
